purpose: Reference pack for redesigning Bolivian Electric OS MVP UI without copying third-party assets, code, copy or brand identity.

design_read.surface: B2B industrial CRM plus commercial quote funnel
design_read.audience: Bolivian Electric management, commercial team and B2B buyers requesting electrical products
not_language: full ecommerce promise before stock and pricing validation
design_read.recommended_direction: Industrial control-room UI for the app, with a product-led commercial quote page. Use restrained charcoal, porcelain, steel borders and one amber/electric accent.

source_summary.use_policy: component taxonomy and interaction discovery only; license review before code reuse
useful_for_bolivian_electric: categorizing app shell, forms, inputs, tables, tabs and quote CTAs
avoiding generic all-purpose blocks by choosing components by job
compact interaction ideas for search, filters and status controls

source_summary.use_policy: MIT/open component architecture reference, retokenize before use
useful_for_bolivian_electric: dashboard with sidebar, charts and data-table composition
app shell split into sidebar, site header, section cards and table
accessible component structure for future Supabase-backed app

source_summary.use_policy: landing structure and category research only
useful_for_bolivian_electric: business, corporate, technology, ecommerce and hardware categories
reference density for real-world landing hierarchy
separate hero, proof, product/category and CTA sections

source_summary.use_policy: motion taxonomy and patterns only unless imported from licensed repo
useful_for_bolivian_electric: subtle reveal, disclosure, transition panel, animated number and toolbar ideas
microinteractions only where they clarify state or feedback
avoid heavy motion in management dashboard

source_summary.use_policy: structure only; no code reuse for commercial client work
useful_for_bolivian_electric: short feature rhythm
integration and FAQ ordering after hero
clear CTA hierarchy with one primary action

source_summary.use_policy: typography reference; verify font licenses before production
useful_for_bolivian_electric: avoid default Inter-only look
use clear sans hierarchy for industrial B2B
reserve mono only for operational numbers and codes

source_summary.use_policy: quality floor only, do not copy client identity
useful_for_bolivian_electric: Bench, Garabato and HSB Engineers as internal standard for hierarchy and seriousness
content must help sell, decide, understand scope, understand risk or take the next step
no filler sections

bolivian_electric_ui_rules: CRM is management-first for about 5 users, not company-wide ERP.
Use dashboard density for decisions: pipeline, responsibility, follow-up, import health and web requests.
Commercial page must generate quote requests, not promise direct checkout.
Chatbot UI must behave as knowledge base and human handoff.
Import UI must communicate approval, validation and errors before load.
No real customer data, secrets, prices, margins or supplier information in the repo.
No direct server integration in phase 1.

recommended_visual_tokens.secondary_functional: deep teal only for brand/system identity and links
recommended_visual_tokens.radius: 8px for app surfaces, 999px only for compact pills

recommended_screens: Dashboard: control-room overview with pipeline, SLA, import health and top follow-ups.
Clientes: scannable table with owner, branch, primary contact and account state.
Cotizaciones: pipeline table plus compact activity rail.
Productos: catalog cards as quote triggers, not ecommerce cards.
Solicitudes web: inbox-style cards with source and next action.
Base de conocimiento: approved answer cards with human-handoff flags.
Configuracion: roles and imports as governance, not generic settings.
Web comercial: industrial hero, quote form, category selection and safety rules.

asset_note.recommended_generated_asset: 16:10 industrial electrical warehouse or control-room hero image with cables, panels, shelves and warm work light. No real logos, no people, no readable brands.
asset_note.reason: The commercial page will feel much more premium with a real generated bitmap instead of a CSS-only system visual.
